scope: Current macOS personal-use baseline and shared Web reading core; not a claim of general-distribution or all-matrix acceptance.
authorization: User requested commit and submission of V1 after the latest walkthrough fixes, and separately accepted deferring two known quality/performance issues.
included: EPUB, PDF, TXT and Markdown import and reading
Progressive PDF reading edition, original-source location, visible preparation progress and service readiness
Original-first formulas with on-demand recognition and persistent reuse
Explicit page/region enhancement, replay, scope and quota guards
Focus reading, bound-paper page turns, native trackpad gestures and layout anchors
Cross-paragraph and partial-word selection, draggable selection endpoints
In-reader AI configuration and contextual translation/grammar tools
Notes, image notes, bookmarks and within-book return history
macOS client lifecycle and optional registered OCR runtime
Latest disabled-boundary cursor, cross-book return, repeated-open graphics memory and original-dialog dismissal fixes

accepted_deferrals.issue: Occasional slow page-turn frames under conversion CPU load
accepted_deferrals.evidence: One candidate turn P95 36.2 ms exceeded the 34 ms gate; retained as failure, not relabelled pass.

accepted_deferrals.issue: Academic translation terminology and qualification scope
accepted_deferrals.evidence: Actual self-hosted-model samples retained semantic ambiguity; unsuccessful prompt candidate was reverted.

unverified_or_limited: Clean-machine installation, signing/notarization and broad distribution
Complete physical sleep/wake and final native input-speed/device matrix
Full final UI coverage for same-name distinct PDFs, native pause/reopen/resume and local-access-lock lifecycle
OCR accuracy is independently sampled ordinary text, not a guarantee for every page, formula or language
Long-duration memory stability and every performance gate are not established by the targeted memory repair

validation.method: Inherited direct walkthrough evidence plus targeted actual Web/native re-walkthroughs of affected flows; no new unit tests or full E2E rerun for this source-freeze operation.

release_checks.credential_pattern_scan: No high-confidence credential patterns found in candidate files; not a full security audit

scan_import.environment: Actual native client with own Omarchy GPU; OS file cache not purged; not screen-first-paint timing

scan_text_quality.boundary: Fixed independent body-text sample; worst individual paragraph 97.345 percent

native_memory.unit: MiB physical footprint of responsible process group
native_memory.boundary: Same large display, no forced GC; removed repeated 210.125 MiB graphics allocation retention without lowering resolution

Inside click and inside-to-outside drag keep original view open
Close X still works after reopening
Native position stayed 14–15/20; Web position stayed 36–37/40
Protected profile, notes, bookmarks and translation table digests unchanged

installed_artifact.tag_tracks: Product/source baseline; internal historical package and bundle version labels preserved to keep the installed tested artifact unchanged.
